_comment: Precomputed findings for the fictional sample proposals. Used by demo mode (no API call). Every quote is re-verified against the sample files at runtime and in tests/demo.test.js.

turnstile-labs.summary: Integrated resale marketplace (Turnstile Exchange); venue sets price floors and caps per event or section.

evidence.quote: Turnstile One includes Turnstile Exchange, a fully integrated resale marketplace.
Venues set resale price floors and price caps per event or per section

turnstile-labs.summary: Rotating barcodes refresh every 15 seconds; scanning continues up to 12 hours offline.

evidence.quote: rotating barcodes that refresh every 15 seconds
scanning continues for up to 12 hours without internet connectivity

turnstile-labs.summary: States 42,000 purchases in the first 10 minutes of an on-sale; virtual waiting room (Turnstile Queue).

evidence.quote: Turnstile One has processed 42,000 ticket purchases in the first 10 minutes of a single on-sale.
Every high-demand on-sale is protected by Turnstile Queue, our virtual waiting room

turnstile-labs.summary: PCI DSS Level 1 Service Provider; current Attestation of Compliance (March 2026) included as Appendix B. Appendix B itself was not among the provided files.

evidence.quote: Turnstile Labs is certified as a PCI DSS Level 1 Service Provider.
Our current Attestation of Compliance, dated March 2026, is included as Appendix B.

turnstile-labs.summary: 24/7 event-day support; guaranteed 10-minute response for Severity 1 issues.

evidence.quote: Event-day support is available 24/7 from our Network Operations Center.
For Severity 1 issues, we guarantee a response within 10 minutes.

turnstile-labs.summary: Purchase flow independently audited to WCAG 2.1 AA; dedicated ADA inventory tool.

evidence.quote: The Turnstile One fan purchase flow has been independently audited and conforms to WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
hold, release and sell accessible seating and companion seats through a dedicated ADA inventory tool

turnstile-labs.summary: Lists fan fee ($4.25/ticket), venue license ($180,000/yr), 2.6% processing, and resale buyer/seller fees.

evidence.quote: Fan service fee: $4.25 per ticket.
Venue platform license: $180,000 per year.
Payment processing: 2.6% of gross ticket revenue, charged to the venue.

turnstile-labs.summary: Native Salesforce connector. Turnstile compatibility with the arena's specific model is not yet confirmed.

evidence.quote: Turnstile One includes a native Salesforce connector that syncs fan profiles and purchases nightly.
compatibility with the arena's specific turnstile model will be confirmed during discovery

turnstile-labs.summary: Standard plan is 75 days from signature to first live on-sale.

evidence.quote: takes 75 days from contract signature to the first live on-sale

pulsegate.summary: Integrated resale with venue-set minimum price. Price caps are not available yet (roadmap: second half of 2027).

evidence.quote: Venues can set a minimum resale price for each event.
Resale price caps are on our product roadmap for the second half of 2027.

pulsegate.summary: Dynamic barcodes rotate every 30 seconds; scanners have an offline mode.

evidence.quote: dynamic barcodes that rotate every 30 seconds
our scanners switch to offline mode and continue validating tickets against a locally stored list

pulsegate.summary: Virtual waiting room and auto-scaling are described, but no throughput figure is given for the 15,000-in-10-minutes requirement.

evidence.quote: elastic cloud infrastructure that scales automatically for high-demand on-sales
Fans enter a virtual waiting room before purchase when demand is high.

pulsegate.summary: States PCI DSS Level 1 compliance; Attestation of Compliance is only available on request under NDA, not provided.

evidence.quote: PulseGate is a PCI DSS Level 1 compliant service provider.
Our Attestation of Compliance is available on request under NDA.

pulsegate.summary: Venue owns all fan and transaction data; export any time; complete export within 30 days of termination.

evidence.quote: Harbor City Arena will own all fan and transaction data collected through PulseGate Live.
we will deliver a complete data export within 30 days of contract termination

pulsegate.summary: Purchase flow conforms to WCAG 2.1 AA; accessible and companion seating managed as a separate inventory class.

evidence.quote: Our purchase flow conforms to WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
Accessible and companion seating can be managed as a separate inventory class

pulsegate.summary: Fan fee $3.10/ticket; no annual license; venue pays 2.9% processing.

evidence.quote: Fan service fee: $3.10 per ticket.
The venue pays a 2.9% payment processing fee on gross ticket revenue.

pulsegate.summary: Bidirectional Salesforce integration. Turnstile compatibility is stated only for "most major manufacturers", not the arena's specific system.

evidence.quote: PulseGate Live offers a bidirectional Salesforce integration for fan profiles, purchases and attendance.
Our entry system is compatible with turnstiles from most major manufacturers.

pulsegate.summary: Estimated go-live of about 120 days exceeds the 90-day requirement.

evidence.quote: We expect Harbor City Arena to be live in approximately 120 days from contract signature.

bleacher-box.summary: Fan-to-fan resale with venue-controlled price floors and caps.

evidence.quote: Fan-to-fan resale with venue-controlled price floors and caps

bleacher-box.summary: Rotating QR codes are offered, but an internet connection is required to validate tickets at the gate.

evidence.quote: Mobile tickets with rotating QR codes
An internet connection is required for ticket validation at the gate.

bleacher-box.summary: Virtual queue available. The only volume figure given is 8,000 tickets in the first hour, below the stated 15,000-in-10-minutes requirement.

evidence.quote: Bleacher Box has handled on-sales of up to 8,000 tickets in the first hour.
A virtual queue can be enabled for any event.

bleacher-box.summary: Venue owns its data and can export CSVs at any time. Export upon contract termination is not mentioned.

evidence.quote: The venue owns its fan and transaction data.
Data can be exported as CSV files at any time from the venue dashboard.

bleacher-box.summary: 24/7 event-day support by phone and chat; 15-minute guaranteed response for critical issues in the SLA.

evidence.quote: Our support team is available 24/7 by phone and chat on event days.
Critical issues receive a response within 15 minutes, guaranteed in our service level agreement.

bleacher-box.summary: Fan fee ($2.50/ticket) and no venue license fee are stated. Payment processing fees are not stated.

evidence.quote: Fan service fee: $2.50 per ticket. No license fees for the venue.

bleacher-box.summary: Salesforce integration would have to be built on the REST API. Turnstile integration is not mentioned.

evidence.quote: A Salesforce integration can be built using the API.

bleacher-box.summary: Most venues live within 45 days of signing.

evidence.quote: Most venues are live within 45 days of signing.
